paper_title: Evidence for light-by-light scattering and searches for axion-like particles in ultraperipheral PbPb collisions at $\sqrt{s_\mathrm{NN}} =$ 5.02 TeV
coupling_convention: g_agamma = 1/Lambda in GeV^-1 (approximate values estimated from Fig. 7 description and stated cross-section limits)
notes: CMS ultraperipheral PbPb collision search for pseudoscalar ALPs via gamma-gamma -> a -> gamma-gamma, mass range m_a = 5-90 GeV. The paper sets 95% CL limits on the production cross section sigma(gg->a->gg) in the range 1500-20 nb, converted in the paper (Fig. 7) to limits on g_agamma = 1/Lambda. No numerical g_agamma values are provided in the text or tables; the emitted data_points are APPROXIMATE estimates of the observed exclusion curve (Fig. 7, photon-only coupling scenario aF~F/4Lambda) and should be replaced by a proper digitization of the published figure. Paper claims best limits over m_a = 5-50 GeV for photon-only coupling (and 5-10 GeV including hypercharge). Assumes 100% ALP branching to diphotons. This is a collider bound, not a dark matter search, so no local DM density is assumed. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.45, 5))
